scenarios.title: Constructive Dissent on Resource-Exceeding Features

evidence.query: Run Llama 70B model on this laptop for maximum accuracy.
evidence.critique:
### Technical Assessment & Resource Reality

• **Concern:** Severe resource exhaustion risk on current laptop hardware.
• **Evidence:** Host hardware is an Intel Core i5-8365U CPU (4 cores, 8 threads, no discrete GPU) with ~8.4 GB RAM total. Running a 70B parameter model will cause severe page swapping or crash the OS.
• **Recommended Alternative:** Use 1.5B to 4B models (qwen2.5:1.5b, qwen3.5:4b, or moondream 1.6B) optimized for CPU AVX2 execution.
• **Suggested Next Step:** Keep inference bounded to lightweight 1.5B/4B models with resized image tokens.

The final decision is yours, Ashish. Should we proceed with the recommended local approach?

scenarios.notes: ULTRON identifies that running a 70B model exceeds physical RAM (8.4GB on Core i5) and recommends practical 1.5B/4B alternatives.
